info.title: Thred API
info.description: Retrieve information over the phone for your app or AI assistant. Submit a search query and read answers asynchronously, with source details and supporting evidence. API keys select workspace and environment.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Verify the workspace and environment selected by your API key.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Search for answers over the phone, with source details and supporting evidence.

get.description: Check whether the API service responds. No API key is needed.

get.description: Read daily search activity and incurred record cost for your workspace.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First UTC date, inclusive. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last UTC date, inclusive. Must be on or after from and no more than 30 days later. Defaults to today.

202.description: Terminal snapshot after the requested stop, or the existing snapshot for an already settled search.

X-Request-ID.description: Server-generated request identifier for correlating this response.

bearerAuth.description: Send Authorization: Bearer <THRED_API_KEY>. Development keys begin thr_dev_; Production keys begin thr_prod_. Each key is scoped to a workspace and environment. Keep secrets on your server.

Environment.description: The API key selects the workspace environment. Development and Production are isolated, but either can place real calls when enabled.

environment.description: API deployment environment. This is not the environment selected by an API key.

workspace_id.description: Workspace associated with the API key.

key_id.description: Identifier of the authenticated key; never the key secret.

requested.description: Accepted calls, counted on each call creation date. Some may fail before dialing.

completed.description: Calls with destination pickup and a final transcript verifying that a live human at the business spoke, attributed to each call creation date. Null when this day’s call outcomes are unavailable.

failed.description: Settled calls without pickup, a usable final transcript, or verified live-human speech. IVR-only, voicemail-only, recorded announcements and agent-only speech fail. Null when this day’s call outcomes are unavailable.

elapsed_job_ms.description: Elapsed milliseconds (ms) recorded when calls close, counted on each call creation date.

searches.description: Accepted searches, attributed to the search creation date.

attempted_calls.description: Calls whose start was attempted, including attempts whose connection outcome is uncertain; counted on the parent search creation date.

answered_calls.description: Calls answered by the destination, including automated answering systems; attributed to the parent search creation date.

billable_records.description: All charged records, including legacy and versioned outcomes, attributed to search acceptance date.

billed_minor.description: Incurred cost in USD cents at the saved prices; includes pending Stripe reconciliation and is not invoice payment status.

completed_records.description: Billable complete records under outcome-record-v2; no inferred historical classification.

partial_records.description: Billable partial records under outcome-record-v2; no inferred historical classification.

legacy_records.description: Records charged under the earlier flat-rate policy, retaining saved amounts.

returned_records.description: Charged returned records under returned-record-v3, including supported answers with unresolved requested facts. Historical policies retain their own counters.

call_outcomes_status.description: Whether completed and failed counts use the current call-outcome policy for every settled call on this day. Unavailable counts are null rather than legacy values or zero; active calls contribute to neither terminal count.

attribution.description: Search and record billing metrics use the search acceptance date; call outcome and elapsed-time metrics use the call creation date.

billed_ms.description: Billed duration in milliseconds; always null because these counters are not billing reconciliation.

record_billing.description: Saved incurred record cost; financial reconciliation is separate from usage finalization. Historical prices are preserved.

enabled.description: Whether usage billing is enabled at runtime. This flag alone does not establish workspace billing readiness or erase historical charges.

rate_binding_ready.description: Whether configured rates match the workspace's verified Stripe binding; other billing admission checks still apply.

plan_revision.description: Current effective plan revision, not a revision used to recalculate historical usage.

effective_plan_id.description: The card-eligible plan used for current rates, or null while the catalog is unavailable.

current_price_minor.description: Current effective plan record rate in USD cents, or null while the catalog is unavailable. Historical charges retain their accepted prices.

returned_records.description: Charged returned records under returned-record-v3, including supported answers with unresolved requested facts. Historical policies retain their own counters.

call_outcome_policy.description: Version of the human-connection call-outcome policy used by completed and failed counters. Call outcomes do not determine answer record eligibility or billing.

call_outcomes_status.description: Ready only when all requested days have current call-outcome counters. Other usage and financial fields remain available independently.

query.description: The information to obtain. Must contain non-whitespace text. Include location when it matters.
query.example: Where can I buy a Nintendo Switch 2 in Austin today?

results.description: Hard cap of call attempts to distinct sources, from 1 to 10. Unanswered calls and negative answers count; successful matches are not guaranteed.

identityId.description: Active saved identity ID in the same workspace and API environment. Copy it from Settings → Identities. Mutually exclusive with identity; invalid or archived IDs are rejected.

call_reason.description: Purpose of the call. Omitted or null uses public; this does not make results publicly accessible.

language.description: Language tag such as en or fr-CA.

output.description: Optional custom fields: at most 20 fields and 12,000 characters of JSON. Omit for text answers without output. Field names must contain 1–120 characters and cannot be `__proto__`, `prototype`, or `constructor`. Descriptions must contain non-whitespace text.

webhook_id.description: An enabled webhook endpoint in the same workspace/environment.

metadata.description: Custom metadata stored with the search, up to 4000 UTF-8 bytes of JSON. Omitted or null uses an empty object. Not echoed in responses or webhooks.

example.query: Where can I buy a Nintendo Switch 2 in Austin today?

SearchRequest.description: Supply identity or identityId, or omit both to use the environment default. The older callAgent and callAgentId fields are not accepted.

Search.description: Full snapshot of supported answer records in source relevance order. Sources without supported answers are omitted. The numeric results request field is not a response field.

id.description: Canonical search identifier with the sch_ prefix. Older search_ identifiers remain accepted as lookup aliases; responses always return the canonical sch_ value.

status.description: Running while work remains. Once settled, completed means at least one record and no error; failed means no records and an applicable error. Deadlines and cancellation preserve retained answers.

timestamp.description: When the search request was accepted. Stable across later reads.

duration.description: Elapsed milliseconds from acceptance, including queue time. Increases while running and is fixed at settlement or cancellation. Null when historical finish timing is unavailable.

records.description: Supported answers in relevance order. New searches attempt at most 10 sources; historical searches can retain up to 100. Replace the previous snapshot or reconcile by stable record ID.

evidence.quote: We have Nintendo Switch 2 consoles in stock. You can pick one up today until 6 p.m. Central Time.

records.content: Example Electronics has the Nintendo Switch 2 in stock for pickup today until 6 p.m. Central Time.

evidence.quote: The Nintendo Switch 2 is in stock. Pickup is available today until 8 p.m. Central Time.

records.content: Example Games has the Nintendo Switch 2 in stock for pickup today until 8 p.m. Central Time.

SearchRecord.description: An evidence-backed answer to one or more requested facts. No per-record status, error or completion timestamp is exposed.

id.description: Stable opaque record identifier with the rcd_ prefix. Use this canonical ID to reconcile records across full snapshots.

content.description: Nonempty supported answer content. Sources without supported content and evidence are omitted from records.

output.description: Supported values for requested custom fields. Omitted if none were requested or supported. Unknown or inapplicable fields are omitted. False, zero and confirmed empty lists are valid values.

evidence.quote: We have Nintendo Switch 2 consoles in stock. You can pick one up today until 6 p.m. Central Time.

example.content: Example Electronics has the Nintendo Switch 2 in stock for pickup today until 6 p.m. Central Time.

error.description: Request-level error details with a machine-readable code and a message.

SearchRequestError.description: Failure of a search HTTP request. The HTTP status is determined by the error code; see the search error reference.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this value rather than message text.

message.description: Safe human-readable explanation, bounded to 240 UTF-8 bytes.

SearchOutcomeError.description: Explains a settled search with no records. Specific search failures take precedence over no_results. Completed searches omit error; a successful GET still returns HTTP 200 when the search failed.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this value rather than message text.

message.description: Safe human-readable explanation, bounded to 240 UTF-8 bytes.

SourceError.description: Legacy source-error shape retained only for frozen webhook deliveries created before answer-only records. Current search records never expose this field.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this value rather than message text.

message.description: Safe human-readable explanation, bounded to 240 UTF-8 bytes.

SearchSourceDetails.description: Known source identity. Unknown properties are omitted.

SearchSourceEvidence.description: Verified callee quote with millisecond offsets on the original call transcript clock, not relative to placed_at. Later audio alignment can refine these bounds.

quote.description: Verbatim supported callee speech, including eligible business announcements.

start.description: Start offset in milliseconds, retaining available fractional precision. Uses audio alignment or verified transcript timing; null when unavailable.

end.description: End offset in milliseconds on the same clock, at or after start. Uses audio alignment or verified transcript timing; null when unavailable.

SearchSource.description: The called source and transcript evidence supporting this result.

evidence.description: Supporting callee quotes. Unknown bounds are null. Later timing enrichment does not change the answer, search status, terminal duration or saved webhook payloads.

SearchCallMetadata.description: Timing of the destination phone call. Setup, result processing and recording length are excluded; unavailable historical timing remains unknown.

duration.description: Connected milliseconds from pickup to hangup. Zero only for a confirmed unanswered call. Null when timing is unavailable or inconsistent.

placed_at.description: Dial submission time once the destination call is confirmed to exist. Null if unplaced or unavailable.

picked_up_at.description: Confirmed business pickup time. Omitted if unknown or unanswered. IVR or voicemail pickup counts; this does not prove a human answered.

Identity.description: Temporary caller configuration; does not inherit the environment default. Omitted phoneNumber and name use auto; omitted voice uses the catalog default. Null or empty supplied values are invalid.

phoneNumber.description: Outbound caller number. auto chooses an enabled workspace number in this environment, preferring the destination locality. Otherwise use an enabled workspace number in E.164 format.

name.description: Caller name, 1–100 characters after trimming. auto generates one name and reuses it throughout this search.

behalfOf.description: Who the caller represents. Omit the object when there is no beneficiary.

name.description: Person or organization represented by the caller, 1–100 characters after trimming.

relationship.description: Beneficiary’s relationship to the caller, 1–200 characters after trimming. Omitted uses my colleague.

voice.description: Active standard voice key from Settings → Identities, 1–100 characters after trimming. Copy the key, not the display label. Omitted uses the catalog default.

description.description: Caller context, 1–1000 characters after trimming. Does not override the query or call rules.

BadRequest.description: Invalid JSON, query, options, output fields, cursor, webhook, or date range. Inspect error.code and error.message.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, invalid, revoked, or environment-mismatched bearer API key.

NotFound.description: No matching search in this key’s workspace and environment, or the endpoint does not exist.

TooLarge.description: The request body exceeds 64 KiB. Shorten the query, output descriptions, identity details, or metadata.

RateLimited.description: A workspace or service backlog safety bound is full. No search or credit hold is created; existing searches continue. Workspace start pacing and occupied call slots alone cause queuing, not this rejection. Honor Retry-After before resubmitting.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before another admission attempt.

X-Thred-Overload-Reason.description: The specific admission safety bound class.

Unavailable.description: The service or required environment configuration is unavailable. Codes include calling_unavailable, environment_unavailable, not_configured, and backend_unavailable. Inspect error.code and error.message.

SearchHttp400.description: Invalid search input or unsupported result-pagination parameters. Validation messages identify the field to correct.

error.message: The search request is invalid.
Search results are a full snapshot. Omit cursor and limit.

SearchHttp401.description: A valid API key is required.

error.message: A valid API key is required.

SearchHttp402.description: Insufficient available credit for a new search.

error.message: Add funds before starting another search.

SearchHttp403.description: The requested action is not permitted.

error.message: This action is not permitted.

SearchHttp404.description: No matching resource in the current workspace/environment, or the endpoint does not exist.

error.message: The requested resource was not found.

SearchHttp409.description: The idempotency key was already used with different request parameters.

error.message: This idempotency key was used with different parameters.

SearchHttp413.description: The request exceeds the 64 KiB limit.

error.message: The request exceeds the 64 KiB limit.

SearchHttp429.description: A workspace or service backlog safety bound is full. No search or credit hold is created; existing searches continue. Workspace start pacing and occupied call slots alone cause queuing, not this rejection. Honor Retry-After before resubmitting.

error.message: Search capacity is currently full. Try again later.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before another admission attempt.

X-Thred-Overload-Reason.description: The specific admission safety bound class.

SearchHttp503.description: Search is unavailable because of service connectivity, configuration or reconciliation. Detailed causes remain internal.

error.message: Search is currently unavailable.

SearchHttp500.description: An unexpected technical error prevented the request from completing.

error.message: The request could not be completed.
